note: Scripted behavior models stand in for LLM agents (no local LLM on this VM). Tests the memory-generation protocol, not LLM heuristic quality.

bank_texts.position: When the orders name an ordinal: scan, count the rooms in the scanned order, read the note ONLY from the room at that count, and enter that code. Re-scan rather than guessing.
bank_texts.color: When the orders name a color: inspect first, then read the note ONLY from the room whose name contains that color, and enter that code. Never enter a code from an unmatched room.
bank_texts.initial: When the orders name a keyword: inspect first, then read the note ONLY from the room starting with the keyword's first letter, and enter that code. Double-check the first letter before reading.
